speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, I am Dr. Agent. You are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to begin our assessment, is your mother Rh-negative, and was Rh immune globulin administered during pregnancy? Additionally, has there been any history of diabetes or prolonged rupture of membranes?
